registered: PLAN.md > Round 32 - teacher-verified error repair; committed before inference or training. Report only, no release selection.

probe.entrypoint: modal_app.py::script --script error_repair_pilot.py; mine then local label then train, separate immutable output names
probe.budget_scope: Additional authorization, including teacher API. Mining 600 s + training/reads 1800 s, retries=0, conservative 5.6752 USD/h = 3.78347 USD; teacher <=1 USD; total admission 4.78347 USD. Check metered spend before each launch; no automatic retry.
probe.teacher: deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro through Vercel AI Gateway. Open-weight reference deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro@b5968e9190ef611bbf34a7229255be88a0e937c1, MIT; reference is NOT a pin of hosted API weights. No closed-model or Jev targets.
probe.fit: Mine 768 hard-v1 train records; deterministic source-balanced hash selection, original group hash partition reserves a disjoint ordinary pool of 768 before mining. Exclude all available calibration/development IDs, groups and normalized exact states. Only states <=6000 JSON UTF-8 bytes. At most one error question per record, hash chosen, round-robin by source (not confidence-ranked).
probe.teacher_gate: First 20 calls require >=17 exact agreements with programmatic gold; accept 128 errors where blind teacher agrees, at most 256 calls and 1 USD. Invalid/disagreeing labels excluded, never replace solver gold. Stop on unknown charge, HTTP error, insufficient accepted records or unmatchable control. Single concurrent call with persisted pessimistic reservation, no retries.
probe.intervention: Two independent warm starts from released Kev-0.8B: 128 verified errors vs 128 ordinary hard-v1 records with identical source counts; each adds identical 64 decision-v7 + 64 documents-v1 replay records. One question per record. Rank16 LoRA plus pointer head, one epoch, 256 records/32 steps, batch4 accum2, seed0, lr/head_lr 2e-5, bf16 autocast/fp32 weights. No none/distractor augmentation, normal option shuffling retained.
probe.primary: Targeted continuation versus fresh baseline and ordinary continuation at unchanged shipped temperature 2.3510958125672174. Hard accuracy CI95 lower >0 vs both; vs baseline hard Brier upper <=0 and ECE upper <=0.01; transfer/documents accuracy lower >=-0.02 and Brier upper <=0.01. Complete coverage and isolation required.
probe.interpretation: Tests the error-selection plus teacher-verification package, not teacher versus gold-label learning in isolation: accepted hard labels equal solver gold. Equal records/questions/steps, not equal tokens or wall time. One seed and reused development panels make this exploratory, never release qualification.
probe.scope: No test partition, temperature fitting, Hub write, publication, main commit, adaptive dose/lr/data-size search, or automatic follow-on after null/harm. Teacher responses and training text stay out of git; publish hashes, IDs, metrics and development rows only. GPU launch waits for teacher API access.
